$comment: Query-parameter reordering (URL-CANONICALIZATION.md §3.3.5 rule 4). P signs ?b=2&a=1; proxy reorders to ?a=1&b=2 for cache normalization. Both ends sort pairs bytewise lex by key, reaching the canonical query a=1&b=2.
name: query-reorder
scenario: Cloudflare argo / Go net/url re-serialize / OpenAPI client alphabetize
$comment_duplicates: Duplicate keys preserve original RELATIVE order per §3.3.5 rule 4. E.g. ?tag=a&tag=b stays tag=a&tag=b after sort because tag==tag and a-then-b was the original order.
